sitewide.title: Sitewide description still says the Library is about to open
sitewide.detail: Library: “Independently operated presidential library in Medora, North Dakota, dedicated to the life, legacy, and ideals of Theodore Roosevelt. Opens July 4, 2026.” · Website: “The official website of the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, opening July 4, 2026 in Medora, North Dakota.”
sitewide.fix: Update the description in the sitewide schema (Drupal Metatag/Schema settings) to present tense, e.g. “Presidential library and museum in Medora, North Dakota, dedicated to the life, legacy, and ideals of Theodore Roosevelt. Opened July 4, 2026.” AI tools copy this sentence into answers.

sitewide.title: Sitewide markup doesn't link to the Library's Wikipedia or Wikidata entry
sitewide.detail: sameAs lists only social accounts. Wikipedia and Wikidata links are how search engines and AI tools confirm that trlibrary.com is the same Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library they know about.
sitewide.fix: Add these to sameAs in the sitewide schema.

sitewide.title: 236 pages point to a Theodore Roosevelt entity that is never defined
sitewide.detail: Every /tr page says it's about https://www.trlibrary.com/tr/#person, but no page says who that is: no name, no Wikidata link. To a machine it's an empty placeholder, so the link to the real Theodore Roosevelt is lost.
sitewide.fix: Define the entity once in the sitewide @graph (so every page carries it). This is the single highest-value change for the /tr section.

sitewide.title: www.trlibrary.com has no llms.txt
sitewide.detail: llms.txt is a plain-text guide that tells AI tools what the site covers and which pages matter. A draft built from the sitemap is attached.
sitewide.fix: Review the draft, then ask FiveJars to serve it at https://www.trlibrary.com/llms.txt.

sitewide.title: Restaurant and store hours are listed as the museum's hours
sitewide.detail: The museum entity carries 15 hours entries, including restaurant, store hours. Machines can't tell which hours mean the museum is open.
sitewide.fix: Keep only museum hours on the Library entity. Give the restaurant and the store their own entities (Restaurant, Store) with their hours, linked with containsPlace.

sitewide.title: No admission information in the markup
sitewide.detail: “How much are tickets?” is one of the most common visitor questions. The markup has no price or ticket link.
sitewide.fix: Add admission offers (and isAccessibleForFree: false) to the Library entity.

sitewide.title: 35 unaliased /node/ URLs are in the sitemap
sitewide.detail: These are duplicate addresses for pages that have proper URLs (or old, unpublished-looking items). They waste crawler time and split signals between two addresses.
sitewide.fix: Ask FiveJars to leave unaliased /node/ URLs out of the XML sitemap.

sitewide.title: 22 pages have dates without a colon in the time zone
sitewide.detail: For example datePublished “2020-10-27T06:00:00-0600” on /about/press/press-releases/trplf-announces-100-million-commitments-unlocks-50-million-state. Strict ISO 8601 wants “-06:00”, and some validators reject the short form.
sitewide.fix: In the Drupal schema templates, format dateModified, datePublished, endDate, startDate with the PHP date format “c” (e.g. 2020-10-27T06:00:00-06:00).

sitewide.title: 277 articles are labelled og:type “website”
sitewide.detail: Social and AI previews treat them as generic pages rather than articles.
sitewide.fix: Set og:type to “article” on /tr, press release and podcast templates (Drupal Metatag).

groups.label: TR history articles
groups.why: The /tr section is the Library's richest content for AI answers. Article markup says who published it, when it was updated, and that it's about Theodore Roosevelt (linked to his Wikidata entry).
groups.drupal: Add Article JSON-LD to the /tr article template with about = Theodore Roosevelt (the sitewide #theodore-roosevelt entity) and dateModified from the node's changed date.

mainEntity.name: HOW CAN I DONATE?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can make a secure online payment through the website: trlibrary.com/donate . Or, send a check payable to the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library Foundation to: TR Library 401 E Main Ave Ste 201 Bismarck, ND 58501.

mainEntity.name: IF I JOIN A BENEFACTOR SOCIETY, HOW WILL MY DONATION BE USED?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your donation will provide funding for physical and virtual programing and operations to explore the life, legacy, and enduring relevance of Theodore Roosevelt.

mainEntity.name: MAY I DIRECT MY GIFT TO SUPPORT A SPECIFIC AREA OF TRPL?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most powerful way to support the Library is with an unrestricted gift. Unrestricted support gives us the flexibility to direct resources where the need and opportunity are greatest — such as to the programs, conservation, and educational work that will define the Library's future — and it ensures your generosity has the broadest possible impact. That said, we're always glad to hear from benefactors with a particular passion. If you'd like to support a specific area, we welcome the conversation and would be pleased to explore opportunities that align with your interests and the Library's long-term vision. However you choose to give, your support will be recognized through the appropriate Benefactor Society.

mainEntity.name: WHAT IS THE TAX-EXEMPT STATUS OF THE THEODORE ROOSEVELT PRESIDENTIAL LIBRARY?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library Foundation manages the Library and fundraises on its behalf. The Foundation is a tax-exempt 501(c)(3) organization.

mainEntity.name: WILL MY GIFT BE TAX DEDUCTIBLE?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, gifts are 100% tax-deductible to the full extent of the law.

mainEntity.name: WILL I RECEIVE A TAX RECEIPT?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a tax receipt will be provided.

mainEntity.name: WHAT ARE SOME OF THE BENEFACTOR SOCIETY BENEFITS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Benefits include a special welcome packet, the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library e-newsletter and digital recognition (unless anonymity is requested). Additional opportunities for recognition are available based on level of support.

mainEntity.name: HOW LONG DOES MY BENEFACTOR SOCIETY PARTICIPATION LAST?

acceptedAnswer.text: Benefactor Society participation recognizes the total impact of your cumulative giving.

mainEntity.name: DO YOU SELL OR SHARE BENEFACTOR INFORMATION WITH THIRD PARTIES?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, we do not.

mainEntity.name: MAY I MAKE AN ANONYMOUS GIFT TO JOIN A BENEFACTOR SOCIETY?

acceptedAnswer.text: Certainly, simply specify your desire to remain anonymous when you make your gift and your request will be honored.

mainEntity.name: WILL MY NAME BE PRINTED IN MATERIALS OR PUBLISHED IN ANY WAY?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, digital recognition (unless anonymity is requested) and additional opportunities for recognition are available based on level of support.

mainEntity.name: I HAVE MORE QUESTIONS. WHO CAN I REACH OUT TO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Please contact us at giving@trlibrary.com .
